personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center prioritizing glanceability, live metrics, and robust utility for drivers and parents.

spacing.rule: Dense but clear. Use md (12) for inner padding, lg (16) for outer screen margins. Sticky action containers must have breathing room above the safe area.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for elevation instead of blur.
Keep the interface sharp and performant for budget devices.
dont's: No blur effects, no glass tabs, no translucent sheets. Clarity beats aesthetic.

screens.name: Auth (Login)
screens.purpose: Simple Phone/OTP login routing users to their respective role dashboards.

states.error: Inline red text below input with retry

screens.layout: Minimalist single-column centered layout. Huge numeric keypad integration, giant 'Send OTP' brandPrimary button sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Driver Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for the driver to start/end trips, manage batches, and mark absentees.

states.empty: Illustration of an idle bus with 'No active batches assigned today'.
states.error: Full screen error with 'Failed to load route data' and giant Retry button.

screens.layout: Top half: Massive 'START TRIP' or 'END TRIP' button (color-coded, fills width). Bottom half: Stacked list of batches and students. Each student row has a quick-action toggle for 'Mark Absent'.

screens.name: Parent Live Tracking
screens.purpose: Live map view showing vehicle marker and ETA.

states.empty: No active trip screen with 'Bus hasn't started yet'.

screens.layout: Top 60%: Full-bleed map view with moving bus marker. Bottom 40%: Persistent bottom sheet (surfaceSecondary) showing Trip Status timeline (Started, On Way, Reached), ETA in large display font, and latest alerts.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of all active trips, subscriptions, and user management.
screens.layout: Grid-based utility layout. Top row: Live active trip counters (large metrics). Scrollable lists for drivers, parents, and subscription tracking below. Use segmented controls for fast switching between entities.

driver_avatar.alt: A cartoon character wearing a blue shirt and a blue hat

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility DARK design principles. Keep contrast high, typography large and glanceable.
The target demographic includes small city drivers; ensure tap targets are HUGE (minimum 56pt) and text is highly legible (DM Sans + Rajdhani for metrics).
No glassmorphism or blur effects. Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary to maintain high performance on budget Android devices.
Driver App: Ensure the Start/End trip buttons are always visible, sticky at the bottom or massive at the top.
Parent App: The map should take up the majority of the screen, with a clean bottom sheet containing ETA and timeline.
Admin App: Present metrics using condensed display fonts (Rajdhani) for numerical superiority.
Implement the 'gradient-to-dark scrim pattern' when rendering text over the hero image on the login screen.
Ensure all lists have distinct visual hierarchy. A live tracking dashboard is not the place for subtle aesthetics. Make statuses (Active, Delayed, Completed) pop with the designated status colors.
